affray.name: Water With Blood
affray.description: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective that was controlled by your opponent at the start of the turn.

strike.name: Invasive Species
strike.description: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control every objective that can be controlled within enemy territory. If there are no objectives within enemy territory, you complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control every objective that was controlled by your opponent at the start of your turn.

domination.name: All Roots Entwined
domination.description: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control every objective on the battlefield that can be controlled.
